title: On dynamic price formation in the course of capital reallocation driven by differential rates of profit: strict conservation of value supports Karl Marx's theory
abstract: arXiv:2609.29346v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a dynamic three-sector model in which Marx's aggregate equalities (total price equals total value and total profit equals total surplus value) are treated as strict conservation constraints throughout capital reallocation and technical diffusion. Three price-value coefficients are determined by the two aggregate equalities and a closure that sets one sector's price-based profit rate equal to the contemporaneous value-based average (the anchor). Before innovation, capital inflow expands the receiving sector's output and, under both anchors, lowers its unit price and excess profitability. This endogenous fall in price as output rises supports a two-timescale reading: demand-related price movements may precede slower adjustment through capital mobility. translated_title: 论由利润率差异所驱动的资本再配置过程中的动态价格形成：价值的严格守恒支持卡尔·马克思的理论
translated_abstract: 我们构建了一个动态三部门模型，其中马克思的总量等式（总价格等于总价值、总利润等于总剩余价值）在资本再配置和技术扩散的全过程中被视为严格的守恒约束。三个价格-价值系数由这两个总量等式以及一个闭合条件共同确定，该闭合条件将某一部门基于价格的利润率设定为等于同期基于价值的平均利润率（即“锚”）。在创新发生之前，资本流入扩大了接受部门的产出，并且在两种锚定方式下均会降低其单位价格和超额盈利能力。这种随产出增加而出现的价格内生下降，支持了一种双时间尺度的解读：与需求相关的价格变动可能先于通过资本流动实现的较慢调整过程。一项节省劳动、提高资本密集度的创新会产生暂时性的额外剩余价值，重估已投入的资本，并改变整个经济的利润率。在实际工资保持不变的情况下……
tldr: 本文构建了一个将马克思总量等式作为严格守恒约束的动态三部门模型，表明由利润率差异驱动的资本再配置过程中价格的内生形成以及创新带来的剩余价值动态，为马克思的价值与价格理论提供了支持。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a dynamic three-sector model that treats Marx's aggregate equalities as strict conservation constraints, showing that endogenous price formation during profit-rate-differential-driven capital reallocation and innovation-generated surplus value dynamics support Karl Marx's theory of value and price.
